claim_text_zh: 奥古斯都出生于公元前63年9月23日，本名盖乌斯·屋大维（Gaius Octavius）。
claim_text_en: Augustus was born Gaius Octavius on 23 September 63 BCE in Rome.

claim_text_zh: 其生父盖乌斯·屋大维曾任裁判官与马其顿总督，约前59或58年去世。
claim_text_en: His father was Gaius Octavius, a praetor and proconsular governor of Macedonia, who died in 59 or 58 BCE.

claim_text_zh: 其母阿提娅·巴尔巴·凯索尼亚为凯撒的外甥女。
claim_text_en: His mother Atia Balba Caesonia was the niece of Julius Caesar (daughter of Julia Minor, Caesar sister).

claim_text_zh: 据苏埃托尼乌斯《奥古斯都传》7.1，幼年屋大维获得别号“图里努斯”（Thurinus），纪念其父在图里击败斯巴达克斯残部。
claim_text_en: According to Suetonius (Aug. 7.1), the infant Octavius received the cognomen Thurinus, commemorating his father's victory over Spartacus followers at Thurii.

claim_text_zh: 凯撒遗嘱（前45年存放）指定屋大维为主要继承人，继承四分之三产业，条件为接受凯撒之名。
claim_text_en: Julius Caesar will (deposited 45 BCE) named Octavius as his principal heir, bequeathing three-quarters of his estate on condition he assume Caesar's name.

claim_text_zh: 前44年5月接受凯撒遗嘱后，屋大维改名盖乌斯·尤利乌斯·凯撒。现代史家习惯称其前44–27年间为“屋大维”（Octavian）。
claim_text_en: After accepting Caesar's will in May 44 BCE, he adopted the name Gaius Julius Caesar. Modern historians conventionally call him Octavian for the period 44–27 BCE.

claim_text_zh: 遗嘱收养在法律上存在争议——正式自权收养（adrogatio）通常需在养父生前通过库里亚法完成。屋大维前43年8月成为执政官后才通过此项法律。
claim_text_en: The testamentary adoption had legally ambiguous status. Full adrogatio normally required a lex curiata during the father's lifetime. Octavian had this passed only in August 43 BCE after becoming consul.

claim_text_zh: 后三头同盟——屋大维、马克·安东尼与雷必达——于前43年10月在博诺尼亚成立，前43年11月27日由《提提乌斯法》赋予法律依据。
claim_text_en: The Second Triumvirate—Octavian, Mark Antony, and Lepidus—was formed in October 43 BCE at Bononia and formalized by the Lex Titia on 27 November 43 BCE.

claim_text_zh: 三头统治下发起的公敌宣告（proscriptions）导致西塞罗于前43年12月7日被杀。
claim_text_en: The proscriptions initiated under the Triumvirate resulted in the execution of Cicero on 7 December 43 BCE.

claim_text_zh: 前42年10月腓立比战役击败刺杀凯撒的布鲁图斯与卡西乌斯，二人相继自杀。
claim_text_en: The Battle of Philippi (October 42 BCE) resulted in the defeat of Caesar assassins Brutus and Cassius, who both committed suicide.

claim_text_zh: 前42年1月1日凯撒被神化为“神圣尤利乌斯”（Divus Iulius），屋大维成为“神之子”（Divi filius）。
claim_text_en: Caesar was deified on 1 January 42 BCE, making Octavian Divi filius (son of the divine).

claim_text_zh: 前36年瑙洛库斯海战击败塞克斯图斯·庞培，此役胜利归功于阿格里帕。
claim_text_en: Sextus Pompeius was defeated at the Battle of Naulochus in 36 BCE, a victory won by Agrippa.

claim_text_zh: 前36年雷必达因试图将西西里据为己有而被剥夺三头权力，允许以祭司长（Pontifex Maximus）身份隐居。
claim_text_en: Lepidus was removed from the Triumvirate in 36 BCE after attempting to claim Sicily for himself. He was allowed to live in retirement but retained the title Pontifex Maximus.

claim_text_zh: 前32年元老院对克娄巴特拉（而非安东尼）宣战。前31年9月2日阿克提姆海战，阿格里帕指挥舰队击败安东尼与克娄巴特拉。
claim_text_en: The Senate declared war on Cleopatra (not Antony) in 32 BCE. The Battle of Actium was fought on 2 September 31 BCE, with Agrippa commanding the fleet that defeated Antony and Cleopatra.

claim_text_zh: 前30年8月1日屋大维进入亚历山大里亚，安东尼与克娄巴特拉相继自杀，埃及被吞并为屋大维个人管辖的行省。
claim_text_en: Octavian entered Alexandria on 1 August 30 BCE. Antony and Cleopatra committed suicide, and Egypt was annexed as Octavian's personal province.

claim_text_zh: 凯撒与克娄巴特拉之子凯撒里昂（托勒密十五世）于前30年被屋大维下令处死。
claim_text_en: Caesarion (Ptolemy XV Caesar), the son of Julius Caesar and Cleopatra, was executed on Octavian's orders in 30 BCE.

claim_text_zh: 前27年1月16日，元老院授予屋大维尊号“奥古斯都”，并赋予其为期十年的“不稳定”行省指挥权，辖约25个军团中的20个。
claim_text_en: On 16 January 27 BCE, the Senate granted Octavian the honorific title Augustus. He was also given a 10-year command of provinces containing approximately 20 of the ~25 legions.

claim_text_zh: 《功业录》第34章将前27年宪政安排表述为共和国的恢复——此为奥古斯都的自我呈现，不是中立记录。
claim_text_en: The Res Gestae (ch. 34) presents the 27 BCE settlement as restoration of the Republic: "I transferred the republic from my power to the dominion of the senate and people of Rome." This is Augustus's self-presentation, not neutral reporting.

claim_text_zh: 前23年奥古斯都放弃连任执政官，获得终身保民官权力（tribunicia potestas）与高于所有行省总督的统帅权（imperium proconsulare maius）。
claim_text_en: In 23 BCE, Augustus resigned the annual consulship he had held continuously since 31 BCE. He received tribunicia potestas for life and imperium proconsulare maius, giving him authority over all provincial governors.

claim_text_zh: 前12年雷必达去世后，奥古斯都接任祭司长（Pontifex Maximus）。
claim_text_en: Augustus became Pontifex Maximus in 12 BCE after the death of Lepidus.

claim_text_zh: 前2年元老院授予奥古斯都“国父”（Pater Patriae）称号。
claim_text_en: The Senate granted Augustus the title Pater Patriae (Father of the Country) in 2 BCE.

claim_text_zh: 现代史学中奥古斯都通常被称为第一位罗马皇帝。他并不持有名为“皇帝”的宪政职位，其权力来源于同时拥有的多项具体权力（保民官权力、高等统帅权、祭司长）。
claim_text_en: Augustus is conventionally called the first Roman emperor in modern historiography. He held no office named imperator in the constitutional sense; his power derived from a bundle of specific powers (tribunicia potestas, imperium maius, pontifex maximus) held simultaneously.

claim_text_zh: “元首制”（Principate）为现代史学建构。奥古斯都自称princeps（第一公民），避用rex（国王）和dictator（独裁官）。
claim_text_en: The term "Principate" is a modern historiographical construct. Augustus himself styled himself princeps (first citizen), avoiding rex (king) and dictator.

claim_text_zh: 奥古斯都于公元14年8月19日在诺拉去世，享年75岁。据苏埃托尼乌斯（《奥古斯都传》99）记载，其临终遗言为：“戏已演完，鼓掌吧。”（Acta est fabula, plaudite）。
claim_text_en: Augustus died on 19 August 14 CE at Nola, Italy, aged 75. His last words, per Suetonius (Aug. 99), were reportedly "Acta est fabula, plaudite" (Have I played the part well? Then applaud as I exit).

claim_text_zh: 前14年9月17日元老院将奥古斯都神化。提比略继任为元首。
claim_text_en: The Senate deified Augustus on 17 September 14 CE. Tiberius succeeded as princeps.

claim_text_zh: 《神圣奥古斯都功业录》为奥古斯都亲撰的第一人称功德碑记，共35章，原刻于罗马陵墓外的铜柱上。现存最完整抄本为安卡拉（土耳其）的安卡拉铭文（Monumentum Ancyranum）。
claim_text_en: The Res Gestae Divi Augusti is a first-person funerary inscription composed by Augustus in 35 chapters. It was originally inscribed on bronze pillars outside his Mausoleum in Rome. The most complete surviving copy is the Monumentum Ancyranum in Ankara, Turkey.

claim_text_zh: 《功业录》省略了重大失败、以委婉方式提及公敌宣告，并回避政敌姓名。全文强调个人威望（auctoritas）而非正式权力（potestas）。
claim_text_en: The Res Gestae omits significant defeats, proscriptions (mentioned euphemistically), and the names of political enemies. It emphasizes auctoritas (personal influence) over potestas (formal power).

claim_text_zh: 马尔库斯·维普撒尼乌斯·阿格里帕为奥古斯都终身挚友与最得力将领。他指挥了阿克提姆（前31年）与瑙洛库斯（前36年）海战，前18年获授保民官权力，前12年去世。
claim_text_en: Marcus Vipsanius Agrippa was Augustus lifelong friend and most capable general. He commanded the fleet at Actium (31 BCE) and Naulochus (36 BCE). He was granted tribunician power in 18 BCE and died in 12 BCE.

claim_text_zh: 现代学界共识认为奥古斯都本人并非杰出的战场指挥官。其军事胜利主要归功于阿格里帕、提比略、德鲁苏斯与日耳曼尼库斯。
claim_text_en: Modern scholarly consensus holds that Augustus was a poor-to-mediocre field commander personally. His military successes were largely attributable to Agrippa, Tiberius, Drusus, and Germanicus.

claim_text_zh: 前38年奥古斯都与莉维娅·德鲁西拉结婚，婚姻持续51年直至其去世。结婚时莉维娅已怀有其第二子德鲁苏斯。
claim_text_en: Augustus married Livia Drusilla in 38 BCE and remained married to her for 51 years until his death. Livia was pregnant with her second son Drusus at the time of the marriage.

claim_text_zh: 大茱莉亚（前39年生，母为斯克里波尼亚）为奥古斯都唯一亲生子女，前2年因通奸罪被流放。
claim_text_en: Julia the Elder (born 39 BCE to Scribonia) was Augustus only biological child. She was exiled in 2 BCE for adultery.

claim_text_zh: 提比略（莉维娅与前夫之子）在前4年被奥古斯都收为养子及继承人，此前盖乌斯与卢基乌斯·凯撒已相继去世。
claim_text_en: Tiberius, Livia's son by her first marriage, was adopted by Augustus as heir in 4 CE after the deaths of Gaius and Lucius Caesar.

claim_text_zh: 据苏埃托尼乌斯（《奥古斯都传》79），奥古斯都外貌出众，双目清亮，身高约5英尺9英寸（约1.7米），头发微卷呈浅棕色（subflavum）。
claim_text_en: According to Suetonius (Aug. 79), Augustus was unusually handsome, with clear bright eyes, and stood about 5 feet 9 inches (c. 1.7m). His hair was slightly curly and light brown (subflavum).

claim_text_zh: 奥古斯都官方肖像雕塑（如第一门型）自前29年至其去世始终表现青春永驻的理想化形象——这是与共和晚期写实肖像传统刻意区隔的美学选择。
claim_text_en: Augustus official portrait statues (e.g., Prima Porta type) depict him as perpetually youthful and idealized from 29 BCE until his death—a deliberate aesthetic choice contrasting with realistic late-Republican portraiture.

claim_text_zh: 现代史学中，奥古斯都被描述为共和国恢复者还是帝制创立者存在长期争论。学界共识是：他实际上是一位权力最终依赖于军队控制的独裁者，同时维持了共和制度的表面形式。
claim_text_en: Modern historiography debates whether Augustus was a restorer of republican government or the creator of a monarchical system. The consensus is that he ruled as a de facto autocrat whose power rested ultimately on military control, while maintaining republican institutional forms.
